items.headline: Patrick Crayton and Jacurri Brown connect in waning seconds to lift Rice over Temple 31-27
items.description: — Freshman Patrick Crayton Jr. threw a 30-yard touchdown pass to Jacurri Brown with six seconds remaining, lifting Rice to a 31-27 victory over Temple on Thursday night.

items.headline: Richardson's TD grab makes Tulane's late arrival worth it in 20-17 win over Rice
items.description: — Bredell Richardson grabbed a 24-yard pass from Trace Johnson in the fourth quarter to lift Tulane to a 20-17 win over Rice on Saturday night.
